name: Gohoushi Kissa ~Tenshi-tachi ni Omakase~ Airi Hen
original_name: ご奉仕喫茶～天使達におまかせ～ あいり編
source:
Souji is working at a cafe with Airi. There is a unique system that a boy and a girl work together in a pair. As they help each other, they start to love each other.... What will be waiting for them at the end of their erotic life...?
